name: Fes Saïss International Airport
before:
The airport for Fez, about 13 km from the city centre, and the practical arrival for the whole Fès-Meknès region.

It is a straightforward, single runway airport: one asphalt strip of 3,200 metres at an elevation of 579 metres. It passed a million passengers a year in 2017.

Getting into Fez is easy and cheap. Bus number 16 runs regularly between the airport and the city's bus and train stations and takes about forty minutes to the central railway station. Taxis wait at the exit of the passenger terminal and the fare into the centre is fixed at 150 dirhams, which is worth telling a client in advance so there is no negotiation on arrival.
after:

claims.why: True but nine years old (Wikipedia's newest figure is 1,417,881 for 2019). The operator, ONDA, publishes the current figures, but onda.ma answers every request with a Cloudflare bot check (403), which the sweep does not try to get round.

claims.wasBefore: Getting into Fez is easy and cheap. Taxis wait at the exit of the passenger terminal and the fare into the centre is fixed at 150 dirhams, which is worth telling a client in advance so there is no negotiation on arrival.
